pricingNote: One project per package; one reporting period per update. Additional scope and any applicable taxes are excluded. Timing begins after complete inputs are accepted and scope is confirmed.
resourceScope: Labor man-hours and cost allocation only. Material resources, equipment-hour models, independent estimates, quantity takeoffs and procurement are excluded unless separately agreed.

services.name: Primavera P6 Schedule Audit
services.scope: One existing schedule reviewed for logic, critical path, constraints and milestones.
inputs: Current Primavera P6 XER
Scope and milestone requirements
Relevant calendars and execution constraints
services.exclusions: Schedule corrections, rebuilding, resource loading and delay claims are excluded.

services.name: Basic Baseline — Without Resources
services.scope: A focused baseline with WBS, calendars, dependencies, milestones and critical path.
inputs: BOQ or itemized work list with quantities and units
Project dates and milestones
Drawings, specifications and execution constraints
services.exclusions: No labor MH, cost or material resource loading. No estimating or quantity takeoff.

services.name: Basic Baseline — With Resources
services.scope: The basic baseline with client-supplied labor man-hours and cost allocation.
inputs: BOQ or itemized work list with quantities and units
Project dates, milestones and execution constraints
Approved labor MH budgets and assignment assumptions
Cost budgets, allocations and relevant unit rates
services.exclusions: Materials, equipment-hour models, budgeting, unit-rate development and quantity takeoff are excluded.

services.name: Detailed Baseline — Without Resources
services.scope: A detailed CPM baseline, milestone list and narrative for a clearly defined project scope.
includes: Detailed WBS, logic and critical path
inputs: Detailed BOQ or itemized work list with quantities and units
Project dates, milestones and scope breakdown
Drawings, specifications, calendars and execution constraints
services.exclusions: No labor MH, cost or material resource loading. No estimating or quantity takeoff.

services.name: Detailed Baseline — With Resources
services.scope: The detailed CPM baseline and narrative, with client-supplied labor man-hours and cost allocation.
inputs: Detailed BOQ or itemized work list with quantities and units
Project dates, milestones, drawings and execution constraints
Approved labor MH budgets and assignment assumptions
Cost budgets, allocations and relevant unit rates
services.exclusions: Materials, equipment-hour models, budgeting, unit-rate development and quantity takeoff are excluded.

services.name: Primavera P6 Schedule Update — Without Resources
services.revisionLabel: Revision allowance confirmed in your written scope
services.scope: One reporting period: actual dates, remaining durations, CPM and variance review, and a 3-week lookahead.
inputs: Current Primavera P6 XER and approved baseline
Reporting data date
Actual start/finish dates and remaining durations
Accurate progress report
services.exclusions: No labor MH, cost or material updates. Baseline creation, recovery planning and claims are excluded.

services.name: Primavera P6 Schedule Update — With Resources
services.revisionLabel: Revision allowance confirmed in your written scope
services.scope: One reporting period on an existing resource-loaded XER, including actual and remaining labor MH and costs.
inputs: Existing labor/cost-loaded XER and approved baseline
Reporting data date and accurate progress report
Actual dates and remaining durations
Labor MH and cost actuals, remaining amounts and forecasts
services.exclusions: Material updates, new resource dictionaries, initial loading and remapping are excluded.
